privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: What the Activity Kit records about you and why.
privacy.accountBody: You sign in with your eAEP account. We keep your name and email to identify you, save your programs and show your proposals. You can browse the catalogue without signing in.
privacy.usageIntro: To learn which activities are most useful and where the catalogue has gaps, we record three kinds of events:
privacy.eventSearch: the searches you run (text, filters and number of results);
privacy.eventView: the activities whose details you open;
privacy.eventProgram: the activities you add to programs.
privacy.usageLaunch: If you install the app on your phone, we also record each time you open it.
privacy.usageCookie: We use a random identifier in our own cookie, not shared with third parties, that lasts about 13 months. If you sign in, the events from this browser are linked to your account.
privacy.usageNever: We do not store your IP address, your browser or the page you came from.
privacy.usageWho: Only platform administrators see this data, and they can see the name of signed-in users.
privacy.usagePurpose: It is used for statistics that improve the catalogue. The legal basis is the legitimate interest of AEP in understanding and improving the platform.
privacy.usageShared: On a shared computer, events from before sign-in may be linked to whoever signs in first.
privacy.usageOff: At the moment the platform does not record usage data.
privacy.optOutBody: If your browser sends Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track, we record nothing. You can also turn recording off in this browser.
privacy.optOut: Turn recording off in this browser
privacy.optedOut: Recording is off in this browser.
privacy.optOutFailed: Could not save your choice. Try again.
privacy.rightsBody: To ask for access, correction or deletion of your data, write to

about.title: About Kit de Atividades
about.lead: A platform built specifically for Escoteiros de Portugal leaders.
about.missionBody: Kit de Atividades was created to give scout leaders digital tools that make it easier to plan and run high-quality educational activities.
about.visionBody: We want to be the reference platform for scout leaders in Portugal, encouraging the sharing of knowledge and good practice.
about.techBody: Built with modern technologies such as Next.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL for performance, security, and ease of use.
about.devLead: This project is developed in the open, collaboratively
about.devBody: Kit de Atividades is an open-source project for the Escoteiros de Portugal community. Contributions and suggestions are welcome!
